items.Sentence: The wastewater treatment system consists of screening, grit removal...
influent flow equalization and emergency storage...
the original primary clarifier no longer needed with the new treatment process.
Magnesium hydroxide is added via a variable speed auger to maintain optimal pH...
Advanced secondary treatment is provided by two parallel nitrification/denitrification activated sludge processes (two basins and two secondary clarifiers).
Tertiary filtration is provided by a disk filter and sand filter in series operation
Effluent disinfection is achieved using chlorine. The final effluent is dechlorinated prior to discharge to Deer Creek.
the waste activated sludge is ... dewatered by a belt filter press
hauled to Ostrom Road Landfill in Wheatland, CA.
Grit and bar screenings are hauled off-site to a landfill.
emergency backup storage in the old anaerobic digester
